conbody.p: An Investment Trust pools the funds of its investors/ shareholders and invests them in a diversified portfolio of securities. Investment Trusts are typically close ended funds which can be traded on a stock exchange. In Indian markets, 2 types of investment trusts are operational under the appropriate SEBI Regulations.
